content.text: {"core": "Tune fixes things by small adjustments — nudge, check, nudge again — until the feel comes right. Here that fine-tuning turns on the tuning itself: the sense of when something is done. Overdone, that sense never lands — every settled feeling gets reopened, checked once more, adjusted again, and the checking outlasts anything it could confirm.", "sheetLine": "The gauge that says 'done' keeps getting re-read; nothing is ever finished."}
